resources.string: Every label here came from resources and follows the system language
Two instances of the very same component. It holds no state of its own: the value arrives as a parameter, the intent leaves as a callback.
The state lives here, in the parent:
Try typing something in both modes.
mutableStateOf is created anew on every recomposition
Switch the theme in the header. One card changes, the other does not.
Two identical elements. Only the order of padding and size differs — and the resulting bounds differ too.
padding before size: the inset is outside, the blue square stays 120
size before padding: 120 includes the inset, less blue is left
Three columns of different height. Turn intrinsics on: the columns align to the tallest, and the number of measurements stays the same.
A middle column with somewhat longer text
A scrollable container hands its children an unbounded height. A child asking for «all available» is asking for infinity — and it crashes.
turn on outside the lecture only: the app really does crash
The same function, the same variable name inside. Look how many different numbers came out.
toggle it and watch the bottom number
One function, two calls — and two memories. The numbers differ and never drift: the positions are stable.
2. The same function in two if branches
Toggle a few times. The number changes every time — including when you come back to the previous branch. Leaving a branch throws away its slots, and the memory starts over.
Expand the second card, then insert an item at the top. Without a key the neighbour ends up expanded.
identity comes from the item id
identity comes from the position in the list
This is the card local state. It lives in the slot table at the address the container considers this item address.
The search field has nothing to do with the list. Type a letter and watch the two counters: the list and the wrapper behave differently.
ScreenState was created once — same reference
ScreenState is called in the composable body — a new reference every time
a new instance every time, but the content equals the previous one
